value.agent-plugins-1-0-in-vs-code-copilot-cli: GitHub shipped Agent Plugins 1.0, a stable API for third-party tools to integrate contextual actions and workflows into Copilot's agentic loop across VS Code, CLI, and app.
value.multiple-redirect-uris-and-token-refresh: GitHub expanded OAuth capabilities with multiple redirect URIs and optional expiring access tokens with refresh support, closing security gaps and aligning with modern identity standards.
value.grok-4-6-now-available-in-github-copilot: xAI's Grok 4.6 model is now selectable within GitHub Copilot across editors and chat, expanding available frontier models for specialized tasks.
value.gemini-3-7-flash-now-available-in-github: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash is now a selectable model in GitHub Copilot, offering a fast, cost-efficient option optimized for coding and agentic tasks.
value.github-copilot-weekly-releases-august-10: GitHub's August 10 Copilot release brings enhanced multi-file edits, improved agent mode context awareness, and fixes for completions regressions, rolling out to all tiers.
value.copilot-memory-and-ollama-support-in-git: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports Copilot Memory for cross-session context and Ollama integration for local open-source model completions, for Business/Enterprise.
value.rule-insights-for-organizations-now-in-p: GitHub's Rule Insights public preview offers organization-level dashboards showing active, bypassed, and conflicting branch protection rules/rulesets across repositories, expanding previous repo-scoped view.
value.github-enterprise-server-3-22-release-ca: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 RC is available for self-hosted customers, featuring Copilot agent capabilities, improved security dashboards, and upgraded dependency tooling, with production imminent.
value.block-users-from-comments-in-personal-re: Repository owners can now block specific users from commenting on issues/PRs in personal repositories, offering finer-grained moderation without full account blocks.
value.license-data-quality-improvements-across: GitHub improved its automatic license detection engine with expanded SPDX support and better accuracy for multi-license files and specific variants, affecting API and UI.
